description: KNaGeO₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pna2₁ space group. K is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.82-3.26 Å. Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four equivalent GeO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one GeO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.60 Å. Ge is bonded to four O atoms to form GeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent GeO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.73-1.85 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, and two equivalent Ge atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, three equivalent Na, and one Ge atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to four equivalent K, one Na, and one Ge atom.
